page_title: CHE 0-2 BRE | Chelsea v Brentford 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+6' 0 - 2 Goal! Neal Maupay feeds Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
90+5' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is penalised.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+5' He should have scored! Reece James (Chelsea) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.

90+2' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Robert Sanchez anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
87' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
87' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is about to take a corner kick.
85' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Frank Onyeka (Brentford) for a tough tackle.
84' Substitution. Aaron Hickey leaves the pitch and is replaced by Saman Ghoddos (Brentford).
84' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
81' Substitution. Marc Cucurella is replaced by Deivid Washington (Chelsea).
81' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea) replaces Moises Caicedo.
78' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Here is a change. Yoane Wissa is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Neal Maupay (Brentford).
76' Here comes a substitution. Vitaly Janelt is given a rest as he is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
75' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
73' Reece James (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
71' A pass from Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
69' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
69' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
67' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Noni Madueke will be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Reece James (Chelsea) for Axel Disasi.
66' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
65' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
64' The ball is cleared after Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
64' The substitution has been made. Frank Onyeka (Brentford) has replaced Mathias Jensen.
62' Neat passing move from Chelsea in order to create new attacking opportunities.

58' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Bryan Mbeumo finds Ethan Pinnock (Brentford), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Robert Sanchez had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
57' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Having seen unsporting behavior, Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Neal Maupay (Brentford) is the recipient.
54' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
53' The resulting corner, taken by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), comes to nothing.
53' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Robert Sanchez pulls off a great save to deny Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
48' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

48' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Simon Hooper has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
44' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is penalised for holding. Simon Hooper signals a set piece. Chelsea earn a free kick.
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) works the corner short.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Brentford will have an opportunity.

40' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Mark Flekken to get hold of the ball.
38' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

38' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Wonderful pass from Axel Disasi (Chelsea) for Nicolas Jackson, but they can't profit from it as Mark Flekken comes off his line to collect.
33' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
32' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.
32' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
30' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
29' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Noni Madueke (Chelsea) and blew his whistle.
25' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
23' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

21' Ambitious effort from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.

19' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
19' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

14' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simon Hooper with no other option than to blow for a foul.

13' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken was alert and the score remains the same.
12' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
11' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

11' What a great touch by Noni Madueke (Chelsea)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar.

10' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Robert Sanchez shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
7' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
7' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
2' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Brentford will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
